stem: A sanitation task requires splash protection, but goggles repeatedly fog enough to prevent workers from seeing floor hazards. What is the strongest response?
choices: Correct the visibility problem with suitable compatible PPE or ventilation while maintaining required protection before work continues
Remove the goggles so workers can see
Keep the fogged goggles because any PPE is automatically adequate
Ask workers to work faster before the lenses fog
rationale: PPE must provide the required protection without creating an unmanaged secondary hazard; selection and work controls should address both needs.
